title: Senior AWS DevOps Engineer
description: We are seeking a Senior AWS DevOps Engineer to design, build, and evolve shared cloud platform services consumed by product and application teams. This role treats the cloud platform as a product, delivering reusable building blocks, paved roads, and a consistent developer experience aligned with CCoE standards. Responsibilities Build reusable platform capabilities, including shared services, standard compute patterns, and golden baselines, that enable safe, rapid workload onboarding Maintain and enhance centralized services such as logging, monitoring, secrets, identity, file transfers, and key management Co-create paved roads and golden paths in partnership with product teams, security, and operations Collaborate closely with Cloud DevOps/Automation engineers to codify platform interface
